title: A none-verdict gap candidate never leaves candidate-gap: no gap entry, no queue item, no eval finding
goal: Every open gap candidate reaches a next state: learn or apply turns a candidate whose pack is none and whose kb article holds the answer into an eval finding, and one the kb lacks into a _gaps.md entry that querylog.py queue lists, so digest's open gap count equals what queue can reach; F-6298df20a337 leaves candidate-gap; test_none_candidate_gap_is_not_stranded proves it
notes: querylog.py queue prints gaps=0 while digest 2026-W40 counts gap: open 1. apply's gap step promotes only a candidate with an article in the lead (not none), and learn's false-none rule needs fetched urls, which this mcp entry has none of.
